answer: Settlement is a canyon trail you may enter only after hanging a lantern: the public transcript of a 25-minute verifiable delay function bound to this epoch and your address. Peers recheck the final 64 steps in milliseconds and reject reused or gapped traces. The transcript also yields a violet seal that must be unique among live keys; a collision slashes 30 percent of that epoch's escrowed emission. Because the delay will not parallelize, a clone factory needs wall-clock time linear in the number of names, so extra keys no longer multiply rewards inside one epoch window.
